items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: I got a cousin down here in San Diego named Adam Cato. He's a piano player.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. But, um, yeah, I got a cousin down here in San Diego named Adam Cato. He's a piano player. He's your cousin?

Yeah. Adam Cato is your cousin? Yeah. Is he older than you? No. I'm older than him. Is he still living? Yeah. Is he living? Sure. Yeah, but I heard so much talk about him, and I thought he was an old-time legend. No, he's not that old. Uh, do you have his address? I think I got it in that book somewhere. Do I have?
